Not a problem, we both had four slices and I was full halfway through the third. She tells me that it's different and I can't figure out how so I point out how I've finished food she couldn't before and she's no stranger to my germs. She said all of that's different, sharing food with anyone is disgusting. I mean I felt like she called me disgusting and wanted clarification.
